title: IR-Aware ECO Timing Optimization Using Reinforcement Learning
authors: Wenjing Jiang, Vidya A. Chhabria, Sachin S. Sapatnekar
relevance: Direct competitor: RL-based gate sizing for post-PD ECO. Reports Pareto front improvement. Uses 45nm open PDK.

title: GraPhSyM: Graph Physical Synthesis Model
authors: Ahmed Agiza, Rajarshi Roy, Teodor Dumitru Ene, Saad Godil, Sherief Reda, Bryan Catanzaro
relevance: GNN-based timing/area prediction from pre-synthesis netlist. 98.3% delay accuracy. Useful as oracle for ML optimization.

title: GoalEvolve: From Handcrafted Algorithm Priors to Goal-Driven Evolution of Physical Design Algorithms
authors: Haixu Liu, Lei Zhou, Yuhao Ren, Yumao Wu, Zhiang Wang
relevance: LLM-driven OpenROAD full-flow optimization. TNS +30.67% on 8 ASAP7 designs. Shows LLM potential in EDA.

title: E-Layout: Layout-Stage Logic Restructuring via RL-Optimized Equality-Saturated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
relevance: Closest competitor: post-placement logic restructuring via RL+e-graph+RAG. 6% TNS, 2% WNS, -1% area over commercial tool.

title: A GNN-Based Placement Optimization Guidance Framework by Physical and Timing Prediction
authors: Peng Cao, Zhi Li, Wenjie Ding
relevance: GNN placement guidance. WNS +35.66%, TNS +43.51% on OpenCores 22nm. Shows GNN potential for timing-guided optimization.

title: EasySize: LLM-Guided Automatic Analog Circuit Sizing
relevance: LLM for analog circuit sizing. Different domain (analog vs digital) but shows LLM potential for circuit optimization.

title: LATCH: LLM-Agent Tool Chain for Hardware Timing Closure
relevance: LLM agent for FPGA timing closure. Shows agent-based approach to timing optimization.

title: Gate-Level Waveform-Aware Timing Prediction with Transformers
relevance: Transformer-based gate-level delay prediction using SPICE simulation data. Alternative to GraPhSyM for timing prediction.

title: A General-Purpose GNN-Based Timing Optimization Framework for VLSI ECO
relevance: GNN-based ECO timing optimization. General-purpose framework. Direct competitor in ML-based ECO space.
